findings.title: website_name leaks website data for restricted TL0 users
findings.body: UserSerializer adds :website_name to the public attributes but does not add it to untrusted_attributes, unlike :website. When an anonymous or low-trust viewer sees a TL0 user, restrict_user_fields? hides website, but website_name is still serialized. Because website_name is derived from the hidden website, it exposes the user's website host/path. Add :website_name to untrusted_attributes and update the spec.

findings.title: Inclusion guard is missing the question mark
findings.body: include_website_name will not be used by ActiveModel::Serializer, which looks for include_website_name?. As written, the serializer includes website_name unconditionally, even when website is blank, yielding a null field. Rename the method to include_website_name? and base it on the presence of the value that should be exposed.

findings.title: Domain comparison treats unrelated hosts as same
findings.body: The same-domain check drops only the first label of each hostname and compares the rest. This treats unrelated hosts such as forum.co.uk and example.co.uk, or a.github.io and b.github.io, as the same domain, so the serializer will append the website path when it should display only the host. The logic is also asymmetrical for example.com vs www.example.com. Use a proper registrable-domain comparison or a simpler exact/subdomain rule.

findings.title: Untrusted attribute test does not cover website_name
findings.body: The spec's untrusted_attributes list was not updated to include :website_name, so it does not verify that the new derived field is hidden for TL0 users viewed anonymously. Since website is untrusted, the test should also assert that website_name is omitted.

findings.title: website_name can become stale after profile edits
findings.body: The template now binds to model.website_name, but that value is generated on the server and is not recomputed when model.website changes. User#save only updates bio_excerpt from the response, so after editing a profile website the displayed website name can remain stale until a reload. The previous controller computed property observed model.website and avoided this.
